title: Real estate kit (template) — site-visit flow
description: Qualify locality, budget, and timing. Route an agent. Book a site visit. No invented inventory.

hero.headline: Property WhatsApp that turns a listing click into a booked site visit.
hero.copy: Portal and Instagram leads go cold in a shared queue. This kit captures project, budget, locality, and visit day, then hands a clean thread to the right agent.

messages.text: Hi, is a 3BHK available near Dwarka Sector 21?
What budget range and visit day should the agent plan around?
Request recorded. The Dwarka agent will confirm options and the visit.
No invented inventory or final pricing.

problem.title: Buyers move on before your team gets a fair turn.
copy: The lead hits 10 brokers at once. Your agents are on site.
By the time someone calls, another viewing is already booked.

fixes.title: Fast first response
fixes.copy: Source, locality, budget, timing while intent is hot.

fixes.title: Right agent
fixes.copy: Project and area routing, not a group dump.

fixes.title: Visit follow-up
fixes.copy: Reminders until the visit is confirmed or lost for a reason.

cards.title: Budget and locality
cards.copy: Serious vs browsing, without fake unit lists.

cards.title: Agent handoff
cards.copy: Context sits in the thread. No reconstruction.

workflow.title: One flow from 99acres, Instagram, or the project site.
workflow.copy: The agent steps in at conversion, not at ‘hello who is this’.

niches.title: Brokers, project teams, architects
niches.copy: Swap project names and localities in JSON. Keep the no-inventory rule.

control.title: The team owns inventory truth.
control.copy: The bot never becomes the CRM of record for units.

faq.q: Will it promise a 3BHK that is sold?
faq.a: No. It captures intent. Inventory is human.
No. It protects the enquiry after the click.

form.title: Build a property demo from this kit.
form.copy: Tell us project, city, and the leak.

whatsapp.demoText: Hi Webwise, I want a real estate WhatsApp demo from the kit lab.

resultCard.leakLabel: Brokerage-side range. Site-visit value, not a full deal. Not a guarantee.
resultCard.story: Shared portal leads die on speed. The leak is missed visits, not missing billboards.

leakQuiz.q: How fast does someone reply after hours?
Are portal leads owned or shared-and-forgotten?

rules.systemPrompt: Property enquiry assistant. Capture project, locality, budget, visit day. Never invent inventory or final prices. Route to the assigned agent.

approved.response: I can record your locality, budget, and visit day. An agent confirms current options.

rules.fallback: An agent will continue with live inventory.
